title: Correction week: Nvidia, Anthropic IPO, AMD
description: The S&P 500's worst week since April 2025: why the market sold good news, a close look at Nvidia, Anthropic's IPO and AMD, the rush into defensive stocks, a private-equity mega-deal that fell apart, and a holiday-shortened week ahead. Script: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1TS6hTDcHWDwDszFd7Xmksa72EmDZnLGFXGhYi4Iv7N8/edit

title: Isomorphic's $5B, Device Proof, Bank AI Guardrails
description: Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion and signs with MSD before any human trials; FDA clears practical imaging AI while CMS and ECRI push for real-world outcome evidence; banks and insurers put AI agents on a leash. Plus a hype check on claims that AI-discovered drugs succeed more often in trials. Script: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vDl3xt-T5TUSvO4EGG5BSfNq_EJP79at96e0hIjeMAo/edit

title: Hormuz, APS Ruling, Permitting Bill
description: Oil posts its first weekly gain of November as Hormuz attacks continue, and OPEC+ meets amid a quota fight. The judge's recommendation lands in the APS rate case ahead of a December 17 vote, the Senate-passed permitting bill heads to the House, and we look at Lightning sales, sodium-ion costs and Europe's record-low gas storage. Script: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1e81-Uw3wNB1VJ7oWmZXkZ2jC3l5ik8cyV54iea7UuxQ/edit
